name: nimiapp-deeptutor
description: DeepTutor learning workspace for Nimi Desktop
author: DeepTutor contributors

scripts.dev:renderer: corepack pnpm run build:nimi-styles && node scripts/nimi-renderer.mjs
scripts.test:app: node scripts/prepare-nimi-python.mjs && node --test tests/nimi/*.test.mjs && node scripts/nimi-python.mjs -m pytest tests/nimi tests/services/rag/test_llamaindex_pipeline_stall.py tests/services/workspace/test_content_workspace.py -q && pnpm --dir web run contracts:check && pnpm --dir web run test:node
scripts.build:electron:production: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:python && pnpm run build:electron && node scripts/package-electron-production.mjs
scripts.build:python: node scripts/prepare-nimi-python.mjs && node scripts/nimi-python.mjs -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --distpath dist-python --workpath .nimi/local/pyinstaller scripts/deeptutor-backend.spec
